plain_english_revision: The amendment changes the definition of allowable epinephrine devices on K-12 campuses to explicitly include single-use autoinjectors and other FDA-approved systems, replacing a narrower or deleted description.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment advances the policy of broadening access to life-saving epinephrine devices on school campuses by explicitly including single-use autoinjectors and other FDA-approved systems in the allowable definitions, ensuring students have more options for self-administration during medical emergencies.
evidence_quotes: delete lines 23 to 25, inclusive, and insert in lieu thereof the following: a single use device used for automatic injection of a premeasured dose of epinephrine into the human body or another epinephrine system approved by the Federal Food and Drug Administration
